This account has
no face.
No name.
No voice of
its own.
And it gets
paid,
every single month.
Here's how faceless
accounts actually make
money.
One.
Views.
Once you hit
ten thousand followers,
TikTok's Creator Rewards
program pays you
for videos longer
than one minute.
Two.
Affiliate links.
You recommend a
product.
Someone buys it.
You earn a
commission.
And you never
even touch the
product.
Three.
Digital products.
A template.
A guide.
A preset pack.
You make it
once,
and sell it
again,
and again,
and again.
Four.
Brand deals.
When a page
owns a niche,
brands pay to
be seen on
it.
But here's what
nobody tells you.
The views usually
pay the least.
The real money
is in what
you sell.
So the method
is simple.
Pick one niche.
Post every single
day.
And give it
ninety days before
you judge it.
Nobody needs to
see your face.
They just need
a reason to
follow.
